sn12.31:4.2: For a second time, Sāriputta kept silent.
sn12.31:4.4: “Sāriputta, this was said in ‘The Way to the Far Shore’, in ‘The Questions of Ajita’:
sn12.31:5.1: ‘There are those who have appraised the teaching,
sn12.31:5.2: and many kinds of trainees here.
sn12.31:5.3: Now you, being alert, are asked
sn12.31:5.4: to tell me their behavior, good fellow.’
sn12.31:6.1: How should we see the detailed meaning of this brief statement?”
sn12.31:11.2: Seeing this, one is practicing for disillusionment, dispassion, and cessation regarding what has come to be.
sn12.31:11.3: One truly sees with right wisdom that it came to be with that as fuel.
sn12.31:11.4: Seeing this, one is practicing for disillusionment, dispassion, and cessation regarding the fuel for its origination.
sn12.31:11.5: One truly sees with right wisdom that when that fuel ceases, what has come to be is liable to cease.
sn12.31:11.6: Seeing this, one is practicing for disillusionment, dispassion, and cessation regarding what is liable to cease.
sn12.31:11.7: In this way, Sāriputta, one is a trainee.
sn12.31:12.1: And how, Sāriputta, has one appraised the teaching?
sn12.31:12.2: Sāriputta, one truly sees with right wisdom that this has come to be.
sn12.31:12.3: Seeing this, one is freed by not grasping through disillusionment, dispassion, and cessation regarding what has come to be.
sn12.31:12.4: One truly sees with right wisdom that it came to be with that as fuel.
sn12.31:12.5: Seeing this, one is freed by not grasping through disillusionment, dispassion, and cessation regarding the fuel for its origination.
sn12.31:12.6: One truly sees with right wisdom that when that fuel ceases, what has come to be is liable to cease.
sn12.31:12.7: Seeing this, one is freed by not grasping through disillusionment, dispassion, and cessation regarding what is liable to cease.
sn12.31:12.8: In this way, Sāriputta, one has appraised the teaching.
sn12.31:12.9: Sāriputta, regarding what was said in ‘The Way to the Far Shore’, in ‘The Questions of Ajita’:
sn12.31:13.1: ‘There are those who have appraised the teaching,
sn12.31:13.2: and many kinds of trainees here.
sn12.31:13.3: Now you, being alert, are asked
sn12.31:13.4: to tell me their behavior, good fellow.’
